DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely with a chronic bronchitis phenotype given the persistent cough and lack of significant reversibility.

Based on your age, 40 pack-year smoking history, and spirometry showing a fixed obstruction (FEV1/FVC < 0.70) with poor response to bronchodilators, this confirms COPD rather than asthma.
